Description: AM refers to an event in northern Syria affecting the regions of al-Wasim, al-Thughur and also A-Aham (Syria). He is basing on Matthew, Tagribirdi, al-Istakhri (just lists Syrian fortresses but not earthquake damage) and al-Suyuti. The shock was felt across a large area and caused great destruction and casualties. It is not for sure that the fortresses mentioned by al-Istakhri were indeed damaged. However, note that al-Suyuti reports that many fortifications were damaged. Eddesa of Matthew was not damaged and so do other sites. Thus, in the absence of other reports of damage caused by an alleged large earthquake (casualties) and since the fortresses are located along the East Anatolian Fault (EAF), this might imply of the source. GC use the report of Matthew of Edessa to imply of additional event in Edessa region.
